overview: The Medford School Committee received student achievement awards, reviewed department pre-budget presentations, and rejected participation in the state school choice program for 2016–2017. Members also debated terms for an RFP to place a seasonal winter bubble over Edgerly Field and approved a letter to state legislators regarding charter school funding.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from April 11, 2016, alongside routine bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Acceptance of Century Bank Donation for History Guide
items.summary: The committee suspended regular order to accept a donation from Century Bank to print a local history guidebook written by Brooks Elementary teacher Michael Coates.

items.title: Recognition of Scholastic Medal Winner
items.summary: High school freshman Hannah Rogers was recognized for winning a national silver medal in the Scholastic Writing Awards.

items.title: Reports on National History Day and Model UN
items.summary: The committee accepted reports honoring students for participating in National History Day and Model United Nations programs.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: The committee accepted reports from the Committee of the Whole on pre-budget presentations and the Curriculum Subcommittee on homework policy and school accountability ratings.

items.title: Department Pre-Budget Reports
items.summary: Administrators presented FY2017 pre-budget requests and staffing priorities for English language arts, social studies, and school health services.

items.title: Rejection of School Choice Program
items.summary: The committee voted to reject participation in the state non-resident school choice program for the 2016–2017 school year.

items.title: Report on Last Day of School
items.summary: Superintendent Belson announced June 21, 2016, as the final day of the school year with an early release schedule.

items.title: 2016–2017 School Committee Meeting Calendar
items.summary: The committee approved the meeting calendar for the 2016–2017 school year as amended to adjust date conflicts.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: The committee passed condolence resolutions honoring Maria DeLiva and Whitfield Jeffers.

items.title: RFP Development for Edgerly Field Winter Bubble Structure
items.summary: Members discussed proposed specifications for an RFP to lease Edgerly Field for a winter season bubble structure, agreeing to revise terms regarding fees, hours, and penalties before final issuance.

items.title: Charter School Resolution Letter
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution letter regarding charter school funding to be submitted to the state legislature delegation.

items.title: Facility Use Notice and Executive Session
items.summary: Following a brief discussion regarding facility rental procedures for a community event, the committee voted to enter executive session for contract negotiations.
